operation.description:
Lists issue types available for a repository (inherited from its organization owner, with any per-repository overrides applied).
OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Fine-grained access tokens require the "Metadata" repository permission (read).
operation.summary: List issue types for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/issue-type.description: The type assigned to the issue. This is only present for issues in repositories where issue types are supported.

color.description: The color of the issue type.

created_at.description: The time the issue type created.

description.description: The description of the issue type.

id.description: The unique identifier of the issue type.

is_enabled.description: The enabled state of the issue type.

name.description: The name of the issue type.

node_id.description: The node identifier of the issue type.

updated_at.description: The time the issue type last updated.

#/components/schemas/issue-type.title: Issue Type
